name: High Lunar Orbit
story: Elliptical mapping orbits and parking trajectories above 100 km. The 1966 Luna 10 was placed here — the first artefact to enter orbit around any body other than Earth. SMART-1 lingered in highly elliptical orbits to test ion propulsion endurance. Most modern lunar missions transit through HLO before lowering into LLO; some end their life by being raised here to free up the LLO 'workspace' before disposal impact.
comparison: Roughly the altitude of GEO above Earth, but around a body 27% the diameter. The lunar horizon recedes; the spacecraft sees a full lunar disc instead of close-up surface.
